review_evidence: The unit is the single 612-line blog/lean/PsychVerbs/PsychVerbSem.lean module; complete declaration scanning finds 33 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

Direct inspection shows a substantive cognitive-situation semantics for psych verbs: ExperiencerState, CausalPathway, psychVerbSem, compositional bridges, and checked consequences connecting opacity, causation, temporal behavior, and existing Linglib formalizations.

The long-form explanatory comments cite the linguistic literature and document how the formal definitions relate to the retained semantics/pragmatics modules, so the blog location does not make the file disposable.
summary: Retain the PsychVerbs blog formalization: it contains a substantial typed semantic model and 33 checked propositions, not blog-only scaffolding.

summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content: definitions, theorems, and proofs. Eval/Basic.lean defines the Verdict inductive type and Verdict.of function. Eval/Projection/Account.lean defines the Account inductive type with 12 constructors, the Accepts function mapping accounts to their acceptance predicates, and the Stronger relation with reflexivity/transitivity proofs. Eval/Projection/ChemlaSchlenker2012.lean formalizes scoring of accounts against experimental data with predicted/observed/verdict functions and theorems verifying experimental results. Eval/Projection/Map.lean proves 16 edge theorems (stronger-than relations) and 7 cut theorems (non-stronger-than relations) between accounts, with edges_sound and cuts_sound meta-theorems. None are pure import aggregators; all contain unique formal mathematics.
